orchestration: Reader BEGIN -> read state marker -> writer commits coupled state+graph update -> same reader reads graph marker.
interpretation: In this deliberately adversarial acquisition order, the one-file reader kept one old snapshot for both state and graph. The attached-WAL reader acquired state before the writer commit and graph after it, yielding a mixed logical view on every trial.
claim_boundary: Mechanism evidence for same-file snapshot coherence under this workload. Not a universal claim against every multi-store design; explicit epoch/receipt pinning can detect or compensate for cross-store skew at additional complexity/cost.
